Name: Dark Forest
Components: V, M, S (the dried tongue of a village speaker)
Description: Sickness and disease come in many forms, sometimes that form is elation. Choose a point within range, a viscous black bud of a plant appears in that spot, quickly bursting into dark fluid that covers a 15-foot radius around it, turning the area into difficult terrain and forcing any creatures within to pass a Charisma Saving throw or have their movement speed halved until they start their turn outside the difficult terrain as their thoughts are assaulted by an eery elation.
